categories.main_business_segments: The company historically operated in textile dyeing and finishing, specializing in processing silk, cotton, wool, and synthetic fiber fabrics. It also has a semiconductor packaging and testing subsidiary focused on professional communication semiconductor OEM/ODM services. As of 2022, the company decided to exit the textile dyeing and finishing business and transition to real estate leasing as its primary business, while the semiconductor subsidiary continues its operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The textile segment utilized professional dyeing, resin processing, and finishing technologies for various fabrics including pure cotton and blended knits. The semiconductor subsidiary employs advanced packaging and testing technologies for communication chips, including RF high-frequency testing capabilities. The company is pursuing IATF16949 global automotive quality management certification to expand into electric vehicle-related IC products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The textile business primarily served the domestic market with fabric processing services. The semiconductor subsidiary serves both domestic and export markets, notably the United States, focusing on communication semiconductor components. The company’s real estate leasing targets industrial plant and office building tenants.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly based in Taiwan, with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan and related offices. Export markets for semiconductors include the United States, while textile exports historically targeted Vietnam, China, the US, Indonesia, and Cambodia. The company’s leasing business is focused on properties in Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a downstream contract manufacturer and service provider. In textiles, it processes fabrics for customers; in semiconductors, it provides packaging and testing services as an OEM/ODM. The leasing business positions the company as a property owner and lessor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus shifted in 2022 from textile dyeing and finishing to real estate leasing to maximize asset utilization and profitability. The semiconductor subsidiary emphasizes R&D for automotive-grade quality certification (IATF16949) and expanding into electric vehicle IC products. Cost optimization through alternative raw materials and quality improvements are ongoing R&D themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through contract processing fees in textile dyeing and finishing (now ceased), semiconductor packaging and testing service fees, and rental income from leasing industrial plants, warehouses, and office buildings. The semiconductor segment also involves sales of electronic components and materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The report does not explicitly name competitors but positions the company as an industry benchmark in textile dyeing and finishing historically. The semiconductor subsidiary competes in the professional communication semiconductor packaging and testing market, focusing on OEM/ODM services with a strategic move toward automotive electronics. The leasing business competes in the local industrial real estate market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company’s consolidated revenue was approximately NT$396 million in 2022, down 17% from the prior year, mainly due to semiconductor subsidiary revenue decline and textile business exit. Operating profit decreased significantly. The company has total assets around NT$1.38 billion and equity of about NT$1.15 billion. The semiconductor subsidiary experienced a loss in 2022, while the textile business showed slight growth before exit. The company maintains stable capital with 63 million shares issued.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes professional dyeing and finishing expertise with high-quality, diversified textile products historically. In semiconductors, it offers specialized packaging and testing services with enhanced RF testing capabilities and aims for automotive industry certification to differentiate in the electric vehicle market. The leasing business leverages existing industrial assets to provide stable rental income, aiming to maximize asset value and profitability.
